⚡ Moodle AI Quick Answer — Keyboard Shortcuts Guide:

1. Shift + Z — Solve Focused Question: Hover or click any question below and press Shift + Z. A tiny dark notification appears in the top-right corner with the concise answer (e.g., B — Chloroplasts) and automatically disappears after 1 second.

2. Shift + X — Solve via Screenshot: Crops the question region under cursor and evaluates it via Vision AI (ideal for diagrams/code). Disappears after 1 second.

3. Shift + A — Show Last Answer Again: Re-displays the most recent answer for 1 second without sending another AI request.

Minimal visual interference: No permanent panels, no chat interfaces, zero webpage modification!
